Name: John B.
Subject: Interest in contributing to Cisco's Hardware Engineering Team
Body:
Hi John,

I’ve been following Cisco’s continued innovation in high-performance hardware, and I know that the engineering teams are tackling some of the industry’s toughest integration and scale problems. I’m looking for an environment where rigorous engineering discipline is the standard.

My technical work has been focused on digital logic and system architecture. I recently architected a fully configurable L1/L2 cache controller in Verilog, implementing complex coherence protocols and verification environments using Synopsys VCS. I moved beyond simple simulation to understand timing constraints and system integration, aiming to build hardware that is robust from day one.

I am actively pursuing a Hardware or ASIC design internship for Summer 2026. I value the perspective of engineers who are already solving these problems at scale, and I would welcome any direction on how my background might align with the opportunities on your team.

If your group is taking interns, I would strongly appreciate the chance to interview. I am confident I can ramp up quickly on your tools and contribute to your verification or design execution immediately. I have attached my resume and would appreciate a short conversation to discuss how I can help your team this summer.
